description: Ministry of Justice - Order to extend the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, for a further Period not exceeding two years w.e.f. 02.02.2017
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification. It contains an order made under the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No. 2 of 2013, extending the operation of the Act's provisions for a further period. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the primary purpose of publishing a statutory instrument and regulatory extension. The core content is about legal procedures and regulatory matters, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
